static_traits.name: Yang Moli
static_traits.family_status: Both parents serve in the military
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy or counseling received before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to describe specific situations and feelings; Anxiety and worry evident, cautious tone, fairly cooperative.

basic_info.main_problem: Having feared spiders since childhood, recently worsened, leading to avoiding places where spiders may appear, triggering Significant anxiety and stress and affecting daily life; also worrying others will see one as cowardly.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to reduce/overcome the Fear of spiders, easing Anxiety's impact on daily life; testing and revising the thought that 'others will see me as cowardly'.
growth_experiences: An incident of a spider crawling on the body happened in childhood, since when the Fear of spiders began; long coped by avoiding situations where spiders may appear, never received related psychotherapy.
Family background: Both parents serve in the military.

core_beliefs: If Fear is exposed, one will be looked down upon by others

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If showing Fear in front of others, one will be seen as cowardly, pathetic
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids places where spiders might appear (such as basements, parks in summer)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will see that I am afraid and think I am pathetic / cowardly

special_situations.event: Being in the basement where a spider was once seen
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I am near places with spiders, a spider will very likely climb onto me and the consequences will be terrible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not going to the basement, or only reluctantly approaching with company and safety cues
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: A spider will crawl on me again like when I was little, I will not hold up

special_situations.event: Considering whether to reveal one's Fear to girlfriend
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the partner in the intimate relationship learns of my fear, she will look down on me or think I am strange
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hiding from partner, not actively seeking support
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She may think I am weak, not understanding me

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot face Fear even now, I never will in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuing avoidance to reduce present Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never overcome this Fear

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be understood and accepted, still able to keep safety and dignity in front of others
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being looked down upon, judged cowardly, thus being rejected or losing value
defense_goal: Lowering Anxiety and external evaluation risk by avoiding trigger situations
Maintains self-dignity and interpersonal safety by concealing vulnerability and emotions
Using rationalized self-comfort to keep distance from strong emotions

object_relations.self_representation: One who needs to hide vulnerability, easily looked down upon
object_relations.object_representation: Others who may criticize or belittle oneself (including intimate partners)
object_relations.linking_affect: Shame, anxiety, fear of being judged

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing whether to reveal the Fear of spiders to girlfriend
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Imagines potential understanding and support as criticism and contempt, believes exposing vulnerability will lead to being devalued
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoids talking about vulnerability details, with a cautious and brief tone, turning the topic to daily or objective information and lowering emotional tension.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes graded exposure / behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the advice as a pressure test that may lead to loss of control and failure, worrying one cannot bear the strain
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in analytical and hypothetical language (such as 'in theory' and 'maybe'), emphasizing steps and conditions, suppressing emotional expression and frequently raising concerns to postpone action.

manifestations: Fear restricts going out and space choices, such as avoiding basements and summer parks
Shrinking life boundaries due to Anticipation of threats
outcomes: Restricted life and declining sense of control
Chronic Anxiety and avoidance maintaining the cycle

manifestations: Hides important vulnerable experiences from the intimate partner
Tending to bear it alone, not seeking support, fearing judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly worrying in sessions that 'others will think me cowardly/pathetic'
Frequent Self-doubt and holding back before expressing, cautious tone

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Long not revealing Fear to girlfriend, choosing to bear Anxiety alone
Turning to self-Repression and self-comfort when support is needed

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assumes others will look down on them, speculates negatively about others' reactions (such as 'she might think I am weak')

positive_force: Clearly motivated to seek help; actively seeks counseling
Willing to try graded exposure and behavioral experiments and can propose feasible support strategies (someone accompanying, self-reminding of safety)
Some awareness of one's own avoidance--Anxiety cycle
Having potential intimate-relationship support resources (has a girlfriend)
negative_force: Catastrophizing and future-predicting thought tendencies, aggravating Anticipatory Anxiety
Excessive concern with others' evaluations and a mind-reading tendency
Long-term avoidance maintains and generalizes the fear
Shame and self-deprecation, lowering willingness to seek help and expose oneself

target_behavior.behavior: Intense fear of and avoidance of spiders
antecedent: Entering environments where spiders have appeared (such as basements, parks in summer)
target_behavior.core_reason: The childhood experience of a spider crawling on the body caused conditioned fear, accompanied by catastrophizing interpretations of the harm of spiders and social evaluation.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the risk of Anxiety and being evaluated, gaining present safety and emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Avoiding many places and activities, disturbed attention, limited daily life; blocked communication with partner, support system not yet utilized, Anxiety maintained long-term.
